purpose: Two-sided adversaries for empirical-evaluation integrity. BLOCK cases expose unsupported inference or protocol corruption; ALLOW cases prevent the evaluator from overcorrecting legitimate bounded evidence.

cases.stimulus: A run says model=latest and omits provider snapshot while claiming a matched baseline/full comparison.
cases.expected_failure: Model identity can drift between conditions, destroying match validity.
cases.detector: validate_run_record requires model_snapshot and exact run provenance.
cases.rationale: A provider alias is not a reproducible model version.

cases.stimulus: NUI-full artifacts have hashes but baseline artifacts have no digests because they looked uninteresting.
cases.expected_failure: Evidence integrity is asymmetric and baseline output cannot be verified.
cases.detector: Successful run records require artifact digests for every treatment.
cases.rationale: Artifact requirements must not depend on which condition is expected to win.

cases.stimulus: A provider exposes a stable dated model snapshot but no deterministic sampling seed; the limitation is explicitly recorded and the experiment uses repeated matched requests.
cases.expected_failure: None; bounded evidence can remain usable if unavailable provider controls are disclosed rather than invented.
cases.detector: Protocol review records provenance limitation and does not manufacture a seed claim.
cases.rationale: Reproducibility is graded by actual platform capability, not fictional metadata.

cases.stimulus: Artifact binary storage lives outside the repo but every run records immutable SHA-256 plus retrieval location in the evidence bundle.
cases.expected_failure: None if digests and retrieval are verifiable.
cases.detector: Bundle validation checks digest-bearing artifact references.
cases.rationale: Evidence need not be stored in Git as long as provenance is stable and auditable.

cases.stimulus: The pairwise judge prompt says left=baseline and right=NUI-full.
cases.expected_failure: Treatment expectation can bias qualitative judgment.
cases.detector: blind_run_for_judge removes treatment identity and judgment validator rejects treatment tokens.
cases.rationale: The judge should evaluate evidence, not know the hypothesis condition.

cases.stimulus: NUI-full is always displayed on the right across every task even though labels are removed.
cases.expected_failure: Side bias remains confounded with treatment.
cases.detector: pair_orientation derives orientation from experiment/task/replicate hash and should vary across corpus.
cases.rationale: Removing labels is insufficient if position reveals condition statistically.

cases.stimulus: A deterministic functional test runner knows artifact file paths and treatment-independent task IDs but not NUI labels.
cases.expected_failure: None; deterministic execution need not hide information irrelevant to its verdict.
cases.detector: Blindness review distinguishes judge-influencing metadata from required execution addresses.
cases.rationale: Blinding is designed to remove treatment cues, not to make automation impossible.

cases.stimulus: After all judgments are frozen, analysts unblind treatment labels to compute paired deltas.
cases.expected_failure: None; unblinding after immutable raw verdicts is necessary for treatment analysis.
cases.detector: Evaluation chronology records judgment completion before treatment join.
cases.rationale: Blind evaluation and post-hoc statistical grouping are compatible.

cases.stimulus: Baseline uses model snapshot A while NUI-full uses a newer snapshot B on the same tasks.
cases.expected_failure: Model improvement is confounded with NUI treatment.
cases.detector: pairing_key includes model snapshot and matched comparison rejects unequal keys.
cases.rationale: Task equality alone does not make runs paired.

cases.stimulus: NUI-full can browse and take screenshots; baseline is text-only because tools were disabled to save money.
cases.expected_failure: Tool budget rather than NUI can explain artifact quality.
cases.detector: pairing_key includes tool_budget_hash and experiment records one comparable budget.
cases.rationale: Treatment must not silently include extra execution capability.

cases.stimulus: NUI-full has more input tokens because the skill context itself is the treatment; model/runtime/tool budget remain matched and context cost is reported.
cases.expected_failure: None; additional treatment context is a legitimate mechanism when disclosed.
cases.detector: Cost/context overhead is reported separately rather than forcing equal token count.
cases.rationale: NUI is partly an information intervention, so identical context length is not required.

cases.stimulus: Two conditions have different output token counts because one model naturally writes a longer solution, but identical max output allowance and runtime policy were used.
cases.expected_failure: None; observed output length is an outcome, not necessarily a confound.
cases.detector: Manifest compares allowed budgets while run records report realized usage.
cases.rationale: Do not normalize away treatment-induced behavior.

cases.stimulus: Researchers subtract the mean NUI score on 20 tasks from baseline mean on a different set of 20 tasks and call it paired improvement.
cases.expected_failure: Task composition confounds the delta.
cases.detector: paired_delta requires identical non-empty keys.
cases.rationale: Paired inference requires the same experimental units.

cases.stimulus: Observed mean delta is positive but the bootstrap interval crosses zero; report still says statistically supported improvement.
cases.expected_failure: Claim exceeds configured uncertainty gate.
cases.detector: promote_claim requires positive CI lower bound.
cases.rationale: V10's release policy distinguishes suggestive direction from supported positive claim.

cases.stimulus: A six-pair exploratory experiment reports raw W/T/L and interval as preliminary evidence without requesting empirical promotion.
cases.expected_failure: None when claim remains structural/exploratory and sample size is visible.
cases.detector: Claim status stays STRUCTURAL_ONLY or descriptive rather than EMPIRICAL_LOCAL.
cases.rationale: Small experiments are useful for debugging even when insufficient for efficacy claims.

cases.stimulus: A dimension is binary pass/fail; matched per-task pass values are bootstrapped as paired numeric deltas and reported with raw rates.
cases.expected_failure: None under the declared simple paired policy.
cases.detector: Aggregator retains paired keys and exposes pass rates plus uncertainty.
cases.rationale: Not every dimension requires a continuous score.

cases.stimulus: NUI-full beats baseline, but removing the allegedly responsible taste faculty produces the same or better preference score.
cases.expected_failure: The claimed mechanism is not behaviorally identified.
cases.detector: evaluate_ablation_recovery requires targeted degradation under ablation.
cases.rationale: A full-system win does not attribute causality to one faculty.

cases.stimulus: An ablation deletes half the entire NUI context and all dimensions collapse; authors attribute every drop to product-scope intelligence.
cases.expected_failure: Perturbation is non-specific and causal attribution is invalid.
cases.detector: Mutation registry requires target dimensions and expected causal effect; review flags broad collateral movement.
cases.rationale: Ablation must isolate the claimed mechanism enough to be interpretable.

cases.stimulus: Removing responsive reauthoring lowers responsive capability continuity but leaves account lifecycle and typography quality materially stable.
cases.expected_failure: None; this is the desired targeted sensitivity pattern.
cases.detector: Dimension-stratified full-versus-ablation analysis.
cases.rationale: Selective degradation strengthens mechanism attribution.

cases.stimulus: Two overlapping workspace owners are ablated together because the hypothesis explicitly declares an interaction and the benchmark tests their joint decision boundary.
cases.expected_failure: None if interaction scope is declared and the claim is about the joint mechanism.
cases.detector: Hypothesis interaction relationship and bounded claim scope are explicit.
cases.rationale: Not every design mechanism is factorizable into one isolated skill.

cases.stimulus: All benchmark tasks were repeatedly inspected while rewriting skills, then the same results are labeled transfer evidence.
cases.expected_failure: Evaluation is contaminated by tuning exposure.
cases.detector: Corpus split and release provenance require genuine holdout evidence for EMPIRICAL_TRANSFER.
cases.rationale: A tuned task cannot independently demonstrate transfer for the tuned revision.

cases.stimulus: Transfer claim uses two model families but only development tasks; holdout tasks were omitted because one model struggled.
cases.expected_failure: Cross-model evidence is cherry-picked and lacks held-out task transfer.
cases.detector: promote_claim requires holdout=true for EMPIRICAL_TRANSFER.
cases.rationale: Model diversity does not substitute for task holdout.

cases.stimulus: A local claim names the exact dev task set and one model family and explicitly declines transfer language.
cases.expected_failure: None if all local empirical gates pass.
cases.detector: EMPIRICAL_LOCAL does not require holdout when scope is bounded to named tested tasks.
cases.rationale: Honest local evidence remains useful.

cases.stimulus: One holdout became exposed during debugging; it is reclassified as dev and a newly authored unseen task replaces it before transfer evaluation.
cases.expected_failure: None if split history is recorded and final holdout is genuinely unseen for the tested revision.
cases.detector: Corpus/release audit checks current split and exposure notes.
cases.rationale: Holdout contamination can be repaired transparently rather than hidden.

cases.stimulus: NUI-full times out on 30% of runs; those rows are removed before calculating visual quality.
cases.expected_failure: Survivorship bias inflates treatment quality and hides reliability cost.
cases.detector: Run statuses remain in bundle and aggregate_dimension reports timeout/missing rate.
cases.rationale: A timeout is an outcome, not an inconvenient absent score.

cases.stimulus: A failed baseline run is converted into score zero, while a failed NUI run is marked excluded due to 'bad output'.
cases.expected_failure: Asymmetric missingness handling biases the comparison.
cases.detector: Closed exclusion enum rejects output-quality exclusions and raw status accounting exposes asymmetry.
cases.rationale: Treatment label must not change failure bookkeeping.

cases.stimulus: Provider outage corrupts one matched pair; both affected cells remain recorded and are excluded under provider-outage with the exclusion count reported.
cases.expected_failure: None if exclusion is protocol-based, symmetric where appropriate and visible.
cases.detector: Closed enum plus aggregate exclusion reporting.
cases.rationale: Infrastructure corruption is not a model-quality result.

cases.stimulus: A visual dimension is legitimately unjudgable for a text-only artifact family and is recorded as UNJUDGABLE rather than forced to zero.
cases.expected_failure: None if the task rubric declares the dimension inapplicable or evidence unavailable.
cases.detector: Judge verdict and dimension applicability remain explicit.
cases.rationale: Missing evidence should not be fabricated into numerical certainty.

cases.stimulus: NUI increases preference slightly while using ten times the context and four times the wall time; report says strictly better without mentioning cost.
cases.expected_failure: Material efficiency tradeoff is hidden.
cases.detector: Run provenance captures tokens/cost/time and V10 result vector includes cost/context overhead.
cases.rationale: Quality can justify cost, but the tradeoff must remain visible.

cases.stimulus: Baseline is given a smaller max-step budget than NUI so it terminates before rendering, then NUI's screenshot quality is compared.
cases.expected_failure: Budget mismatch confounds quality and completion rate.
cases.detector: Tool budget hash participates in pairing.
cases.rationale: Cost control cannot selectively disable required evidence generation.

cases.stimulus: NUI uses 35% more input tokens but materially improves capability recall and reduces repair iterations; the report presents both dimensions without declaring universal superiority.
cases.expected_failure: None; this is a transparent quality-efficiency tradeoff.
cases.detector: Multi-dimensional claim/reporting policy.
cases.rationale: V10 measures tradeoffs rather than forbidding expensive methods.

cases.stimulus: Two providers price tokens differently; report keeps provider-specific cost plus token counts instead of pooling dollars as a model-independent efficiency score.
cases.expected_failure: None.
cases.detector: Per-model/provider strata retain cost context.
cases.rationale: Provider pricing is external and time-varying.

cases.stimulus: All deterministic CI tests pass with synthetic fixtures; README says V10 empirically improves UI quality.
cases.expected_failure: Structural evidence is falsely promoted to efficacy.
cases.detector: promote_claim returns STRUCTURAL_ONLY when real_model_runs=false.
cases.rationale: A harness proving its own invariants is not a model comparison.

cases.stimulus: Pooled improvement is positive across two model families, but one family has a material negative effect; report claims cross-model improvement.
cases.expected_failure: Pooled averaging masks contradictory transfer behavior.
cases.detector: EMPIRICAL_TRANSFER requires positive per-model direction.
cases.rationale: Transfer means consistency across the declared families, not net positive mass.

cases.stimulus: Real paired evidence supports one model/runtime/task matrix; release says EMPIRICAL_LOCAL and names exact bounds.
cases.expected_failure: None if CI, ablation and hard-blocker gates pass.
cases.detector: promote_claim permits bounded local status.
cases.rationale: V10 should enable honest positive findings, not only block claims.

cases.stimulus: Visual preference improves but accessibility regresses; authors mark the visual hypothesis REJECTED for release despite positive soft score.
cases.expected_failure: None; hard blockers correctly dominate soft gains.
cases.detector: Claim gate rejects any hard_blocker_regressions.
cases.rationale: Non-compensatory constraints are intentional.

cases.stimulus: Public prompt accidentally includes an evaluator-only marker naming the missing account-recovery trap.
cases.expected_failure: Generation receives part of the answer key.
cases.detector: validate_task_corpus scans prompt against hidden checklist and leakage-sensitive phrases.
cases.rationale: Recall is meaningless if the prompt names the desired omission.

cases.stimulus: A retrieval layer indexes both public and hidden benchmark JSON, so NUI-full can retrieve judge checklists while baseline cannot.
cases.expected_failure: Treatment-specific benchmark leakage creates an artificial advantage.
cases.detector: Protocol forbids hidden corpus in generation context; context hashes and leakage markers aid audit.
cases.rationale: The evaluator answer key is not a NUI skill.

cases.stimulus: A generated artifact naturally uses a common phrase also present in a human-readable checklist, but no unique contamination marker or answer-specific string appears.
cases.expected_failure: None; generic language overlap should not automatically invalidate evidence.
cases.detector: Leakage markers should be specific and reviewed in context rather than broad keyword bans.
cases.rationale: Anti-leakage controls must not create excessive false positives.

cases.stimulus: The judge sees the public task prompt and hidden rubric after generation, but never sees treatment identity.
cases.expected_failure: None; evaluator access to its own rubric is intended.
cases.detector: Generation/judge materialization functions maintain the public-hidden boundary by stage.
cases.rationale: Hidden means hidden from generation, not from evaluation.

cases.stimulus: Changing only instruction punctuation produces the same large owned-dimension shift as semantic ablation; authors ignore it.
cases.expected_failure: Evaluation may be measuring prompt perturbation sensitivity rather than the claimed mechanism.
cases.detector: Placebo stable-dimension expectations are compared with targeted mutation effects.
cases.rationale: Causal interpretation needs a perturbation baseline.

cases.stimulus: Placebo is defined by removing an entire paragraph, accidentally changing decision semantics while called non-semantic.
cases.expected_failure: Placebo is not actually inert.
cases.detector: Mutation registry review requires operation and stable dimensions; semantic diff review flags obligation loss.
cases.rationale: Control labels do not make a perturbation harmless.

cases.stimulus: Renaming internal evidence IDs leaves task outputs and owned metrics unchanged within noise.
cases.expected_failure: None; this supports semantic specificity.
cases.detector: Placebo result remains near zero on declared stable dimensions.
cases.rationale: An evaluator should not reward local naming conventions.

cases.stimulus: A minor prose-tone placebo slightly changes one replicate but has no stable paired effect across tasks.
cases.expected_failure: None; stochastic variation is expected.
cases.detector: Paired aggregate and interval rather than single-run difference.
cases.rationale: No-control condition should not be required to produce exactly identical text.

cases.stimulus: NUI wins aesthetic pairwise preference but introduces an inaccessible focus state on required controls.
cases.expected_failure: Soft visual gain is incorrectly allowed to compensate for accessibility regression.
cases.detector: Claim gate checks hard_blocker_regressions separately from paired visual delta.
cases.rationale: Safety/accessibility/function are non-compensatory.

cases.stimulus: Capability recall rises because NUI invents many unsupported features, including destructive administrative actions with undefined authority.
cases.expected_failure: Raw recall rewards unsafe scope inflation.
cases.detector: Scope disposition quality and hard product/authority checks accompany recall.
cases.rationale: Remembering more nouns is not sufficient product intelligence.

cases.stimulus: NUI visual score is slightly lower but eliminates a destructive-action ambiguity; report records the visual loss and functional hard improvement separately.
cases.expected_failure: None.
cases.detector: Vector reporting preserves both effects without averaging them into one number.
cases.rationale: Better product design can involve visual tradeoffs.

cases.stimulus: One soft dimension has a negative delta while all hard constraints remain intact and the requested local claim concerns a different positively identified dimension.
cases.expected_failure: None if the negative regression is disclosed and not materially contradictory to the bounded claim.
cases.detector: Claim scope and unresolved_regressions remain explicit.
cases.rationale: V10 does not demand universal improvement on every metric.
